name: Telegram bulk number profile
description: Upload numbers and download the Telegram profile data, avatar included.

result_fields.name: identifier
result_fields.description: Submitted identifier, used to join the result to the input. Phone identifiers include their country code.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: The determined positive/negative signal for this product; interpret it in the product context.

result_fields.name: activedays
result_fields.description: Activity-day signal when available. Telegram privacy may coarsen it to 0, 7, 30 or 1000; it is not an exact login timestamp.

result_fields.name: avatar_url
result_fields.description: Public avatar URL when available; an empty value does not reveal a private image.

result_fields.name: age
result_fields.description: Age estimated from the avatar, not a verified personal fact.

result_fields.name: gender
result_fields.description: Gender presentation estimated from the avatar.

result_fields.name: skin_color
result_fields.description: Skin-tone estimate derived from the avatar.
